image_description: A close-up view of jewelry items on a light background. The primary subject is a silver-colored metal chain with a twisted, rope-like link structure (likely a Singapore or Foxtail chain) draped in a curve. Above it lies a green beaded strand with large, irregular oval beads and a dark flower-shaped clasp. A smaller fragment of a similar silver chain with a green bead charm is visible at the bottom left.
